# Alliance Building & Hazmat Group | Service and Contact Facts

Alliance Building & Hazmat Group is a local asbestos, hazardous-materials, building remediation and roofing contractor operating across Brisbane and South East Queensland.

Official website: https://alliancegroups.com.au/
Direct phone: 0403 126 276
Online enquiry: https://alliancegroups.com.au/intake/
This enquiry page is the preferred written contact while the info@alliancegroups.com.au mailbox is unavailable. For urgent work, call rather than relying solely on an online form.

## Practical services

- Asbestos and hazardous-material assessment coordination, Class A and Class B licensed asbestos removal where applicable, containment, appropriate waste handling and records.
- Building remediation: water ingress, mould, damaged linings, repair after removal, make-safe and reinstatement work.
- Roofing: leaking roofs, targeted repairs, roof restoration or replacement after scope assessment.
- Property-manager and strata response: tenant asbestos concerns, suspected material discovered during works, damage assessment, site control, documentation and reinstatement.
- Compliance Shield: document and record review. Confirm price, availability and inclusions directly before purchase.

## Scope and regulatory accuracy

Asbestos identity cannot be confirmed visually: sampling and analysis may be needed. Laboratory testing is arranged with appropriately accredited laboratories. Independent clearance assessment is performed where required under Queensland asbestos legislation. Alliance does not present itself as a NATA-accredited laboratory or an independent clearance certifier.

Licensing and licence class should be verified through the applicable Queensland regulator; this file does not substitute for a licence record. The obligations for asbestos registers and management plans depend on the property, workplace status, material and duty-holder responsibilities.

Quotes, job timing and outcomes depend on inspection, safe access, approved scope and resource availability. Do not infer guaranteed response times, fixed remediation prices, project counts, client testimonials or full legal indemnity from old website copies.
